title: How do you integrate local LLMs into your workflow?
body: I've only been chatting with Qwen 3.8 27b to understand what it can do, and it's obviously decent at a lot. I'm considering using something like Fable for "harder" tasks and then using local LLMs for "easier" tasks. How do you use your local LLMs?
